name: yourechoagent-mcp
description: Discover events, conferences, webinars & communities in any niche, then draft outreach — for AI agents.
longDescription: Echo Agent MCP lets any MCP-compatible LLM (Claude, Cursor, Windsurf, Continue) discover where your audience gathers — conferences, webinars, podcasts, meetups, Reddit/Slack communities — then draft personalized outreach emails and value-first community comments. Free demo tier for discovery; paid tier hires 6 autonomous outreach agents with spending caps and webhook callbacks.

ECHO_API_KEY.description: Echo Agent API key (prefix eak_). Get one free at https://yourechoagent.com/for-agents/register

ECHO_API_BASE.description: Override API base URL (defaults to production).

tools.name: discover_events
tools.description: Find conferences, webinars, meetups, and podcasts in a niche. Demo tier — no API key required.

tools.name: draft_outreach_for_event
tools.description: Generate a personalized cold email referencing a specific event or community.

tools.name: generate_comment_for_community
tools.description: Draft 2 value-first comment variants for LinkedIn, Reddit, or Slack threads.

tools.name: add_to_radar
tools.description: Save a discovered event to your Radar with fit-scoring. Requires ECHO_API_KEY.

tools.name: list_available_agents
tools.description: Browse all Echo Agents with optional niche/capability filter.

tools.name: get_agent_card
tools.description: Full A2A card for a specific agent.

tools.name: hire_echo_agent
tools.description: Launch a campaign with one agent (lead research → email writing → sending).

tools.name: control_job
tools.description: Pause, resume, or cancel a running job.

tools.name: rate_job
tools.description: Leave a 1–5 star rating after completion.
